chunks: When a messenger was sent to them by God affirming the Books they had already received, some of them put (His message) behind their backs as if they had no knowledge of it.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says some people threw the Book behind their backs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the 'Naskh' (abrogation) of the Torah by the Jews, who discarded its teachings upon the arrival of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as the final confirmatory messenger. The phrase 'as if they did not know' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to indicate that while they knew the truth intellectually, their arrogance and desire for worldly power led them to willfully ignore it. This incident serves as a paradigm for the transition from the previous covenant to the new Islamic law, emphasizing the continuity of prophetic truth.
